title: SynapX-Harness Skill Activation Contract
description: Minimal T06 protocol: SkillActivationContract is the SOLE authoritative transition artifact from ENABLED to ACTIVE_FOR_JOB. Only Core Admission (HARNESS_CORE_ADMISSION) is permitted to issue this contract. The contract is job-bound and never used as a cross-job capability grant. AUTHORIZED ratification chain is intentionally NOT modeled here (POST_SLICE_DEFERRED).

activation_contract_id.description: Stable identifier for this contract; core-issued and globally unique per job.

extension_id.description: Provider-neutral extension identity (no registry authority claim).

skill_id.description: Skill identity bound to the extension. Independent of registry.

allowed_capabilities.description: Closed capability set per T06 minimal protocol. AUTHORIZED is NOT among them (POST_SLICE_DEFERRED).

issued_by.description: Hard-lock: only Core Admission may issue this contract. Provider/Scheduler/Registry/LLM will be rejected by the validator.

source_revision_ref.description: Source revision kind (H2-I2-R1, 4-member enum restored). The schema ONLY enumerates the four canonical kinds; anything else is rejected. The schema supports Git-only systems at the enum level (GIT_COMMIT accepted), but the activation_validator runtime remains provider-neutral and does NOT prefer or privilege Git-only inputs.

effective_for_job_only.description: Hard invariant: the contract is job-scoped. Cross-job reuse is rejected by the validator.

issued_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for diagnostic receipts.
